preprocessing.description: Serialized preprocessing pipeline including scaling and one-hot encoding applied to integrated product–material features.
preprocessing.note: Preprocessing pipeline outputs 68 features. Feature alignment is handled at inference time for compatibility with individual models.

requirements: No identifier columns (e.g., Unnamed: 0, product_id, material_id)
Feature names must match training schema

deployment_notes: Inference supports both single-row and batch predictions.
Feature dimension mismatch between models is handled explicitly at inference.
XGBoost feature validation is disabled to preserve trained behavior.
